detail: picked "A revised illustration, signed by delivery"

N.J.A.C. 11:4-52.7(b) directly requires a revised basic illustration conforming to the policy as issued, labeled 'Revised Illustration', sent with the policy and signed and dated by the applicant/owner and producer no later than delivery. Option A (amended application) reflects a real-world underwriting practice but is not what the illustration rule requires, so it is not a reasonable second answer to a question framed 'under New Jersey rules'.
Options are similar in length and form; 'revised illustration' echoes the stem's 'as illustrated', but D and B also reference illustrations, so the cue is weak.
